units.rawText: Hehe, you were so confident in the card up your sleeve before. Why are you so apprehensive now?
units.displayText: Hehe, you were so confident in the card up your sleeve before. Why are you so apprehensive now?

spans.text: Hehe, you were so confident in the card up your sleeve before. Why are you so apprehensive now?

units.rawText: Ignoring me, are you? I must say, though, you are absolutely captivating when you fully concentrate~
units.displayText: Ignoring me, are you? I must say, though, you are absolutely captivating when you fully concentrate~

spans.text: Ignoring me, are you? I must say, though, you are absolutely captivating when you fully concentrate~

units.rawText: Even if I already hold victory firmly in my hands, you're quite adept at creating problems for me. Let me think...

units.rawText: Eucharist rests her chin in her hands as she continues to swing her legs about, regarding the board with enthusiasm.

spans.text: Eucharist rests her chin in her hands as she continues to swing her legs about, regarding the board with enthusiasm.

units.rawText: Are you really so confident in whoever is backing you? Are you sure the Sanctifiers won't catch you?
units.displayText: Are you really so confident in whoever is backing you? Are you sure the Sanctifiers won't catch you?

spans.text: Are you really so confident in whoever is backing you? Are you sure the Sanctifiers won't catch you?

units.rawText: Just who exactly is behind you?
units.displayText: Just who exactly is behind you?

spans.text: Just who exactly is behind you?

units.rawText: I act according to what I think is appropriate, of course.
units.displayText: I act according to what I think is appropriate, of course.

spans.text: I act according to what I think is appropriate, of course.

units.rawText: I struggle to believe that you alone are this capable.

units.rawText: ...Hehe, I see these inanities won't fool you.

units.rawText: If you can win this game, Professor, maybe I'll tell you out of the goodness of my heart.
